scope: Frame-distributed AS encounter preparation and HUD data updates; native resource loading/lifetime adapter only. No DWRules engine or rule data edits by this task.
behavior: One asynchronous package request per frame, maximum two in flight; async loading budget 2 ms (an engine budget, not a preemption guarantee).
Wait for mesh/material compilation readiness, then prepare exactly one enemy and its original UICreator health strip per frame.
Stage actors hidden, disable native simulation and tower time during preparation, publish the complete wave together. Explicit pause survives publication.
Keep random draw order, wave counts, rarity, inherited modifiers, native combat and rewards unchanged.
Convert package-only source model paths into complete soft object paths in the AS presentation adapter.
Eight HUD data groups across frames; create rows only when the imported SVG state marks their binding visible. Existing UI assets and layouts retained.
Keep the imported HUD class and streamed model/clip resources in game-instance lifetime, surviving OpenLevel.
Automatic DWOCapture is accepted only in explicitly transient QA sessions; normal launch has no capture argument.

profiling.comparisonNote: Before and after are different captures: prior live play vs deterministic first-wave/retry fixture. Scheduler scope timings are not a steady-combat FPS benchmark.
remaining: First engine startup still finalizes textures (~94 ms in one scope) and waits on initial rendering (~136 ms).
OpenLevel remains a synchronous map transition (~289 ms in this capture); cached HUD avoids repeated multi-second blueprint loading, but map travel itself is not fully asynchronous.

ruleSnapshot.note: No rule files edited here. A concurrent task updated map_core_equipment.json during verification; its changes were preserved.
